GenAiFunction.description: Creates a Draft Media Plan (Quote/AdQuote/QuoteLineItem/AdQuoteLine) for an Opportunity from a human-approved list of Product IDs. Only call this after the user has confirmed which specific products to include - this action requires Agentforce confirmation. This does not check ad-server inventory availability and does not submit anything for advertiser approval.
GenAiFunction.masterLabel: Create Media Plan From Selected Products
